organization.name: EarlyBird / HeyForm
organization.notes: 2024 dates the open-source release announced April 5, not the original product or EarlyBird founding (both unresolved). About explicitly calls EarlyBird a bootstrapped SaaS company, run by Luo Baishun and Wu Qin. No equity investor asserted.

pricingTiers.name: Community Edition
pricingTiers.notes: Software license cost is zero; infrastructure, extensions and external services can cost extra.

pricingTiers.name: Premium
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Most popular. $24/month billed annually ×12; hosted quotas differ from OSS code. Monthly-billed rate not verified.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: $40/month billed annually ×12; 150K responses/month. Commercial Cloud scope, not self-host license.

moats.claim: Differentiation rests on conversational UX and customizable form workflows; a modest ecosystem offers less defensibility than incumbent form platforms.

productReasons.claim: Conversational forms combine varied input types with conditional logic and redirects for adaptive questionnaires.
Visual themes and custom CSS let teams match forms to a detailed brand style.
Drop-off/completion analytics and CSV export help diagnose form performance and reuse collected data.

sponsorship.notes: Official docs request sponsorship but no named corporate financial sponsor verified. EarlyBird is explicitly a bootstrapped SaaS business and supplied as verified steward fallback; testimonials and integrations are not sponsors.

requirements.notes: Official example uses Percona Server for MongoDB 4.4; exact current supported version range not specified.

requirements.condition: Bundled KeyDB OR compatible external Redis

requirements.notes: Bundled in community-edition container; separate Node setup not needed for Docker route.

requirements.condition: Public HTTPS deployment; app itself serves HTTP
Alternative upload storage; local persisted assets in default compose

requirements.component: Stripe, reCAPTCHA/Akismet, OpenAI-compatible API or OIDC provider
requirements.condition: Enable corresponding payment, spam, AI or SSO integration

resources.os: Docker-compatible Linux/macOS/Windows; matching KeyDB image architecture
resources.notes: Official setup guide gives no fixed CPU/RAM/disk minimum.

selfHosting.notes: Default path uses MongoDB and KeyDB; no SQL database. Bull queue settings use Redis-compatible service, not a separate broker. Docker requirements kept distinct from development tooling.

options.name: Zeabur HeyForm template
options.notes: Current self-host docs link this one-click template; custom domain requires APP_HOMEPAGE_URL update.

oneClickInstall.notes: Verified official-link target for Zeabur. Sealos, RepoCloud and Alibaba also named by docs but not independently validated here, so options limited to verified Zeabur target.
